summary: This House resolution expresses support for designating the week of November 3, 2025, as "National School Psychology Week" to recognize the contributions of school psychologists to student success and encourage public awareness of their role.

scores.thoughts: This resolution expresses support for designating 'National School Psychology Week' and recognizes the contributions of school psychologists. While it highlights the importance of school psychologists in education, it does not propose any spending changes or policy shifts regarding public school funding. Its impact on spending is neutral.
